_doc: Claude Code token budget for this project. Counted weighted tokens = input + cache_creation + output + cache_read_weight * cache_read. Budget = weekly_cap_tokens * project_share. weekly_cap_tokens is calibrated from the owner's Claude app usage panel (owner 2026-11-01: 'guide by this'): at 2026-11-01T07:09Z the panel showed 'Todos os modelos' 13% used for the week resetting Saturday 15:59 BRT, while this meter counted 62.17M weighted tokens for the same week, so the cap is about 62.17M / 0.13 = 478M (earlier 201M was a lower bound from one limit error). Re-calibrate from the panel whenever it disagrees with this meter. Owner 2026-11-03: 'pode tirar a trava de tokens, só distribuir melhor' - project_share raised 0.5 -> 0.9 (10% of the weekly cap left so the account limit never stops the routines). Owner 2026-11-04: 'preciso que voce analise ai e faca uma gestao para que a gente consiga utilizar os 100% bater no dia la que tem a renovacao, na verdade no horario que tem a renovacao... organiza ai entre os seus modelos' - project_share raised 0.9 -> 0.97 (3% headroom so the account limit never stops the routines at the very end); `token_budget.py pace` paces the remaining budget to land at the reset, and OPERATIONS 'Model routing and weekly pacing' routes work by model tier.
